results.cypher: MATCH (seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"})<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN a.name AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS other_id, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id IN ["2303.14382", "2510.01656", "2403.05530", "2510.11345"] RETURN p.title AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, p.primary_category AS primary_category, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, a.name AS author ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(target:ArxivPaper) WHERE target.arxiv_id = "2402.04674" MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> target.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(target:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2402.04674"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> target.arxiv_id RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, a.name AS shared_author, p.primary_category AS primary_category ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2402.04674"})<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS shared_authors RETURN p.title AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, p.primary_category AS primary_category, shared_authors AS shared_authors, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25
